# Recommended Implementation Approach

Create a temporary working copy of the source files in an isolated directory or sandbox environment, perform all modifications on this copy, and implement comprehensive logging/audit trails to track every change made. This satisfies the non-modification constraint [ctx_0001] while meeting the auditability requirement [ctx_view_0002], and allows the team to explore implementation options [ctx_view_0001] without affecting the original source files.
